checks.name: stations
checks.sql: SELECT station_id, name FROM tides.main.stations() ORDER BY station_id

checks.name: tide UTC and height
checks.sql: SELECT strftime(time, '%Y-%m-%d %H:%M:%S'), CAST(round(height_m*100) AS INTEGER), event_type, datum FROM tides.main.tide_predictions('8518750','2026-01-01','2026-01-01') ORDER BY time

checks.name: multiple request batches
checks.sql: SELECT count(*), count(DISTINCT time), count(DISTINCT source_url) FROM tides.main.tide_predictions('8518750','2026-01-01','2026-01-16')

checks.name: named interval and datum
checks.sql: SELECT count(*), min(datum) FROM tides.main.tide_predictions('8518750','2026-01-01','2026-01-01', step := 'h', datum := 'MSL')

checks.name: observations preserve null zero QC
checks.sql: SELECT count(*),count(height_m), CAST(round(min(height_m)*100) AS INTEGER), min(quality), min(flags) FROM tides.main.water_levels('8518750','2026-01-01','2026-01-01')

checks.name: current predictions signed conversion
checks.sql: SELECT event_type, CAST(round(velocity_major_mps*1000) AS INTEGER), bin, CAST(depth_m*10 AS INTEGER) FROM tides.main.current_predictions('ACT0956','2026-01-01','2026-01-01', bin := 2) ORDER BY time

checks.name: all-bin currents and daily batches
checks.sql: SELECT count(*),count(DISTINCT source_url), CAST(round(sum(speed_mps)*100) AS INTEGER) FROM tides.main.currents('cb0102','2026-01-01','2026-01-02')

checks.name: bin metadata
checks.sql: SELECT bin, CAST(depth_m*10 AS INTEGER), qc_flag FROM tides.main.current_bins('cb0102') ORDER BY bin

checks.name: join predictions and stations
checks.sql: SELECT s.name, count(*) FROM tides.main.stations() s JOIN tides.main.tide_predictions('8518750','2026-01-01','2026-01-01') p USING(station_id) GROUP BY s.name

checks.name: provenance and timestamp types
checks.sql: SELECT CAST(bool_and(fetched_at IS NOT NULL AND source_url LIKE '%time_zone=gmt%') AS INTEGER), typeof(min(time)) FROM tides.main.water_levels('8518750','2026-01-01','2026-01-01')
columns: CAST(bool_and(((fetched_at IS NOT NULL) AND (source_url ~~ '%time_zone=gmt%'))) AS INTEGER)

checks.name: offline reference table
checks.sql: SELECT sql_function, output_units FROM tides.main.products WHERE output_units = 'm/s' ORDER BY sql_function
